mentions.name: succession
mentions.description: A tool providing infinite context and persistent instruction following for LLM agents by building a persistent, self-resolving identity for the agent. It addresses instruction drift that worsens as instructions get farther from the start of the context, keeping agents grounded in their instructions over long sessions.
mentions.problem: LLMs suffer instruction drift and poor persistent instruction following as context length grows, since system instructions like claude.md are only injected at the start of the conversation.
mentions.source_excerpt: My solution for infinite context, and persistent instruction following (very important for replsh and grounding, LLMs are very bad at using tools outside of their training/harness) is to build a persistent and self-resolving identity for the agent.

evidence.value: My solution for infinite context, and persistent instruction following (very important for replsh and grounding, LLMs are very bad at using tools outside of their training/harness) is to build a persistent and self-resolving identity for the agent.
